// how to use: Copy to ~/.neuralbench/config.json on Newton and replace every <NID> with your login (e.g. ha399973). NeuralBench reads only the named keys below (config_manager.py); the '// ...' keys are comments and are ignored, so they may stay or go.
// USER: your Newton login (NID). Only used to name log folders and the W&B run; no effect on results.
// ENTITY_NAME: W&B entity. We do not use W&B (WANDB_HOST empty), so just repeat the NID.
// SLURM_PARTITION: Partition for every submitted job (#SBATCH --partition). 'normal' has no wall-time limit on Newton; 'short' would reject the 48 h timeout_min in the *_newton YAMLs. Leave empty on a machine without SLURM.
// SLURM_CONSTRAINT: #SBATCH --constraint. Leave empty; the *_newton YAMLs pin nodes with infra.slurm_additional_parameters.exclude instead.
// N_CPUS: Dataloader workers per process (data.num_workers). Keep equal to infra.cpus_per_task in the *_newton YAMLs (10).
// CLUSTER: 'auto' = submit through SLURM when sinfo is available, else run locally. Use null only inside a hand-written sbatch script (see tutorial/neuralbench_slurm_infra.md).
// CACHE_DIR: Preprocessing cache (study parquet, EMG and joint caches, ~400 GB for emg2pose). Shared, already filled; read access is enough once it is complete, but NeuralBench will try to write there for any recording that is missing.
// SAVE_DIR: Run folders (checkpoints, metrics.csv, sbatch logs). Must be writable by you: put it in your own home, replacing <NID>. It is created on first use.
// DATA_DIR: Parent of the BIDS dataset folder: NeuralBench expects <DATA_DIR>/Salter2024Emg2pose/... Shared, read-only is fine.
// WANDB_HOST: Weights & Biases server URL. Empty disables W&B logging (what we do everywhere).
